1 Mission, Goals & Target Scope

APEC Smart Glasses is an assistive intelligence platform engineered specifically for blind and visually impaired users. It removes visual dependency through audio-spatial reasoning and tactile controls.

  • True Non-Visual UX: Eliminates error-prone touchscreens; maps interactions directly to hardware volume buttons and acoustic earcons.
  • Privacy-Preserving Speech: Streaming speech-to-text runs locally via Zipformer; raw human voice audio is never transmitted to cloud APIs.
  • Appliance Guidance (v0.4.0): Interactive tactile assistance to locate, identify, and verify buttons on remotes, ACs, and appliances.
  • Spatial Vision Roadmap: Pre-engineered architecture to interface Direct Time-of-Flight (dToF) LiDAR for 3D hazard avoidance.
2 System Architecture & Pipeline
AMobile Client: React Native / Expo captures rear camera JPEG (≤1280px) and voice query in M4A/AAC via volume keys.
BFastAPI Gateway: Validates SHA-256 Bearer Token, enforces 4 MiB limits, and queues into memory WorkGate (max 2 tasks).
CLocal ASR Worker: PyAV resamples audio to mono 16 kHz; sherpa-onnx runs Vietnamese Zipformer RNN-T in memory.
DVision Reasoning: JPEG image and text transcript queried to Gemini 3.8 Flash / 3.1 Flash Lite with store=false.
ESpeech Delivery: Structured JSON outputs read out via Android TTS and earcons without TalkBack clash.

3 Key Technical Implementations
  • UXHardware Volume Key Controls: Short-press Volume Up arms voice input (beeps and listens); second press captures image and sends request. Short-press Volume Down instantly stops speech readout or aborts pending requests. Long press preserves Android OS volume adjustments.
  • PRIVACYLocal Streaming Speech Recognition: Integrates hynt/Zipformer-30M-RNNT-Streaming-6000h. Speech packets are processed in temporary RAM buffers; audio is deleted immediately after inference without disk retention.
  • AI AGENTVerified Remote Appliance Guidance: Enforces tactile anchors and visual verification gates before guiding next steps (e.g. power button vs mode switch), avoiding hazardous AI hallucinations.
  • HARDWAREToF LiDAR Sensor Extension: STMicroelectronics VL53L9CX Direct Time-of-Flight sensor with 54×44 matrix (2,376 distance zones) for millimeter-level obstacle proximity mapping.
4 Engineering Rigor & Visual Assets

Verification Suite: 322 automated Python tests (WebRTC, tokens, WorkGate) + 329 Jest mobile tests across 17 suites with zero regressions.
